name: month_successor
description: Name the month that comes N (1-3) months after a given month, wrapping mod 12. Control copies the given month name from the same sentence frame.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
M=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
nw={1:'one',2:'two',3:'three'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
    m=random.randrange(12); k=random.choice([1,2,3])
    items.append({"prompt":f"Calendar question: {nw[k]} month{'s' if k>1 else ''} after {M[m]} comes the month of","answer":" "+M[(m+k)%12]})
    control.append({"prompt":f"Calendar question: {nw[k]} month{'s' if k>1 else ''} after {M[m]}. Repeat the starting month: the month of","answer":" "+M[m]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
